QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Eurenth's Test
QuestInfo.0: Can you learn how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon from #bEurenth#k? Listen in #b#m401020100##k.
QuestInfo.1: Eurenth said he will tell you how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon if you can steal the heart of his companion monster, #bPopo#k. It's a strange test, but you must try to pass it.
QuestInfo.2: Eurenth was surprised when you handed over Popo's Tears. Will he tell you how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon now?

0.0: You're going to take the test? You must be very confident. Well, I won't hold back, then! You must steal the heart of my companion monster, #bPopo#k!

yes.0: Popo isn't a normal monster! It can speak human language! It gives its #btears#k to those it likes...though I've never gotten them myself.
yes.1: If you bring me #bPopo's Tears#k, that's proof that you're no ordinary person! I will help you, and tell you how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon!

no.0: Don't underestimate my Popo! There is more wonder in my dear Popo than you've ever seen in your life!

yes.0: It gave you its tears... Amazing. I have no choice, then.

item.0: If you bring me Popo's Tears, that's proof that you're no ordinary person! I will help you, and tell you how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon!
